TraceOS bundles Volatility 3 version 2.28.2 from the PyPI distribution.

Project: https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility3
Release: https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility3/releases/tag/v2.28.2

distributed with the Volatility 3 package for the complete license terms.
